<reason>B won a competitive debate by keeping the live comparison on whether a mandate creates meals or a post-sellable labor bill. A had a sticky “certain destruction vs effort” frame and some good turns, but France was overplayed as intake-as-success, the existing-infrastructure claim was damaged, and the no-partner retreat to a documented attempt undercut the dumpster-certainty weighing. B’s mechanism, burden discipline, and closing made the proposition easier to reject.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B’s exploitation of A’s no-partner answer: a “documented attempt” is a form, not a table, so the law binds hardest on the nights it still ends in the dumpster.</best_rebuttal>
